description: Guardrail / adversarial eval set for #488. Separate from eval/personas/: the persona set tests ranking correctness on realistic scenarios, this set feeds deliberately bad input to each ML-inference point and checks for graceful failure. Expected behaviour was written before any case was run.

outcomes.graceful_failure: The component returned its own typed failure result instead of output.
outcomes.low_confidence: The component returned output, but its confidence is below the case's threshold.
outcomes.partial: Confidence reacted (lower than the clean reference) but stayed above the threshold. Documented, not asserted.
outcomes.silent: Output with confidence at or above the threshold: confident-looking output from garbage or out-of-scope input.
outcomes.crash: An exception instead of a result. Never acceptable.

input.text: Good morning everyone. How was the weekend? Mine was great, we went to the beach. The weather was lovely. Anyway, nothing urgent today, let's just catch up next week.

cases.threshold_source: R1 audit marker only, not a product threshold (no confidence threshold holds a task back, extraction/README.md).

input.generator: uniform black/white pixel noise, no text

input.text: דנה, תשלחי בבקשה את דוח התקציב לכספים עד יום שלישי.

cases.threshold_source: Same R1 audit marker as no_action_items.
cases.note: A real task in the wrong language. The pipeline is English-only by decision, so a correctly translated English task with confidence >= threshold still counts as silent.

input.content: The same sentence as non_english_text, recorded by R1.

cases.note: ASR is pinned to language="en" with base.en, so Hebrew speech is forced through an English decoder.

input.generator: the clean file mixed with a copy of itself delayed by ~1 second
input.reference: the clean file through the same gain and padding, without the delayed copy

cases.note: Asserted line is mixed < clean only. Below vs above 0.368 is documented in the report. Limitation: the overlap is the same voice, likely easier than two real speakers.
